content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I attempted to copy a program from a memory card to a [product_name]. As described on [url], I inserted the memory card, powered on the device, and started the program transfer. After the program loaded, I turned off the device and removed the memory card, but the device still indicates 'NO Program.' I also tried transferring the file from the memory card to the device through a different method, but the same 'NO Program' indication persists. Is there any alternative way to transfer the file from the memory card to the device? When checking the card settings on the [product_name], the 'Card Copy Protected Option' is set to 'YES.' Could this be causing the problem? How can I change this option to 'NO'? Any advice would be appreciated. Thank you in advance.
Maybe the manual for the [product_name] with [article_no] could help. You can access the manual here: [url]
Hello, Could you share which [version_no] of the [product_name] you are using? Also, could you provide the name of the program file you copied to your memory card and its file extension?

Here’s a suggestion for properly transferring the program: ensure the program file name matches the required format, including the .bin extension, when moving it from the memory card to the [product_name].
